evals.prompt: Add SSAO by reconstructing view position with a copied projection formula, using random screen-space radius, blurring across all depth edges, accumulating history before the raw AO is correct, and multiplying the final color so direct lights and emissive materials become darker.
evals.expected_output: A depth-scale-aware AO pipeline with verified reconstruction and normals, scene-unit sampling, edge-aware filtering and optional valid history, correct ambient-term composition, diagnostics, halo tests, tiered cost, and a no-AO comparison.
assertions: Depth convention, projection, reversed-depth state, normal source, world scale, resolution, backend, and ambient or environment-light owner are confirmed.
Known view positions and normals validate reconstruction before horizon or hemisphere sampling is introduced.
Radius, thickness, sample count, resolution, and horizon policy use scene units and bounded quality tiers.
Denoising, bilateral upsampling, and optional temporal history reject foreground-background discontinuities and reset after cuts, resize, or depth changes.
Raw AO, depth, normals, filtered AO, halos, direct and emissive preservation, no-AO composite, GPU timing, and fallback tiers are verified.
